name: Charged Solar Panel
text: Affinity: 2–5. This card can't be played before the last three tricks, and it wins any trick it's played to.
timing: Always on, for the engraved card

signature.effect: can't be played before trick 11, then wins its trick

archetypes: While Held; splash Exact Contractor, High Card
decision: Bidding one sure trick, playing ten tricks one card short in the engraved card's suit (you follow with other cards or count as void there), and choosing which of the last three tricks to take with it.
opponent: The card is hidden until played, then wins visibly; opponents lose one late trick they can't contest, but they can read the holder's forced voids in its suit and lead that suit to make other cards go.
aiNote: Count it as one sure trick when bidding and never bid nil with it; play it on the late trick where losing would hurt most, or last if the team has already taken its bid.
rationale: The low-card affinity locks away a card that would rarely win anyway. One guaranteed late trick (about +10 of base and a safer bid) at the cost of a locked card makes every hand shape around it, and it is always still held at BL-R03's eighth-trick checkpoint; paired on one card through GY-R02 it guarantees Ripening Pear (GR-C10) or, played on the last trick, Patient Hourglass (DU-S10), a three-sigil build-around rather than a free multiplier; it doesn't set the card to ace (Boiling Thermometer, BL-U05, which trumps can still beat); rulings for the conventions: (a) before the last three tricks you don't have to follow suit with it, so it counts as void in its suit, (b) if removal effects leave it your only card before then, you play it, and (c) it wins by its own text even when a rule setter says opponents can't win by trumping (BL-R01, Stilled Hurricane) or reverses rank order (Rewound Reel, PU-U08), with two such cards in one trick going to the later one.
